content:
Apple CarPlay now supports six major third-party AI chatbot apps. Microsoft Copilot is the latest iPhone app to add CarPlay support.

Microsoft Copilot joins CarPlay, making Gemini the biggest holdout

Copilot's addition makes Google Gemini the only major holdout remaining.

Starting Monday, CarPlay will gain a dedicated Siri AI app. This will also mark the official rollout of iOS 27, ending its beta period. Siri AI itself, however, will remain in beta and roll out in waves.

Meanwhile, Microsoft has added CarPlay support to its iPhone Copilot chatbot app. CarPlay's conversational apps require iOS 26.4 or later.

Copilot appears to require a subscription to use on CarPlay. The voice-driven app syncs chat history from the iPhone app, including text conversation threads.

Here's a look at the app in action:

As noted previously, with Microsoft Copilot landing on CarPlay, there is only one remaining major holdout in the AI app space: Google Gemini.

Copilot joins Siri AI, OpenAI's ChatGPT, Perplexity, SpaceXAI's Grok, Meta AI, and Anthropic's Claude as CarPlay options.
